main.text: Donkey website For Donkey's editors The shop's editor desk. This is where the D…

texts: This is where the Donkey team keeps the site up to date: page wording, delivery and returns, contact details, and every product with its price.
Change the words shoppers read on Home, How it works and Contact.
Add products, prices and photos, and choose what shows on the site.
Sign in with the email address your invite came to.
No sign-up here, and nothing on the shop pages links to this door. Your invite email set your password the first time.
Lost your invite email? Write to
and the team will send a new one.
Plain, useful things for the home and the garden, chosen by Donkey and sent out from our workshop.
Donkey, a small shop for everyday things.
